{/* Generated in trunk-io/docs2 from apps/firewatch/docs in trunk-io/trunk-cloud. */}

The shared cache is on by default. An admin can change it in the **Shared cache**
tab on the **Runners** page of the Trunk web app. This page shows the settings
and who can change them.

## Where the settings apply

The tab shows one row for the **Organization default** and one row for each
repository override. To change a row, click **Edit**.

| Level                | What it controls                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Organization default | The settings for every repository. |
| Repository override  | The settings for one repository.   |

**Globally Disable Cache -** From the Shared Cache screen admins can disable all cache functionality for your Trunk Runners. 

## Which branches a job uses cache from

| Value                       | A job uses cache entries from                                                   |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **This branch and default** | Its own branch and the default branch.                                          |
| **All branches**            | Its own branch and the default branch, then any other branch in the repository. |

With either value, a job writes only to its own branch. For Bazel, the setting
applies to the action cache.

<Warning>
  With All branches, a person who can push a branch can change what the default
  branch builds. Keep **This branch and default** for a repository that releases
  from its default branch. For Nix, keep it if you deploy from Nix builds.
</Warning>

## When a change applies

Trunk reads the settings when a job starts. A job that already started keeps its
settings until it ends.
